Class Esp32Cam

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.Esp32Cam
public final class Esp32Cam extends Object
The AI Thinker ESP32-CAM's board features: GPIO, onboard Wi-Fi, its built-in microSD socket, and its OV2640 camera.

    • getSdCard

      public static SdCard getSdCard()
      The card in the AI Thinker ESP32-CAM's microSD socket. Its SdCard.begin() selects GPIO13; the runtime configures the socket's SPI pins (SCK 14, MISO 2 and MOSI 15). The same instance is returned every call.

    • getI2c

      public static I2c getI2c()
      The AI Thinker ESP32-CAM's I2C bus on GPIO26 (SDA) and GPIO27 (SCL), the camera's SCCB pins. An external breakout can share the bus with the OV2640 at its own address. The same instance is returned every call.
